verdict.rationale: Teller documents structured resources per endpoint: balances, ledger transactions, identity with beneficial-owner data, and paginated transaction lists. It also adds category enrichment to transactions, which gives an automated workflow fields it can reason over directly. However, probes found no machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec and no llms.txt, so schemas exist only as prose docs, and the visible enrichment is limited to categorization. Missing for 10: machine-readable published schema (OpenAPI), explicit evidence of the JSON response format and field-level schema detail, richer enrichment such as merchant normalization, and independent hands-on corroboration that the data is agent-consumable.
